baseline: Fresh strict run on afldb_v2_rb_final_test, verified isolated PG16 port 55433
after: afldb_v2_gap029_test: clone plus eight audited manual rookie selections
limitations: Expected IDs use the Gridley namespace, actual IDs use AFLDB; stable profiles and the observed missing-member bridge are retained. Full actual membership is UNKNOWN for unavailable criteria; no empty set or data match is fabricated. The raw report evaluates a sparse bridged identity population, not a complete crosswalk of every Gridley answer.

requirements.approved-deferral: No new approval needed for this bounded criterion scope; acquire the deferred domain or obtain an explicit scope change to close strict parity.
requirements.rookie-draft: Admit independently evidenced Rookie Draft records through audited import, preserving event year, club, pick and stable profile. Existing rookie-relisting-outcomes.csv is triage, not a canonical draft supplement.
requirements.match-event: Recover exact legacy games.match_event labels or independently identify every relevant match using primary event coverage. Date/clubs/venue alone are insufficient.
requirements.sibling: Jarryd/Corey Lyons relationship is primary-sourced; establish Corey canonical identity and in-scope AFL senior participation or owner-approved listed-player semantics. Do not invent an AFL Tables profile.
requirements.registration-2026: Authentic registration and match participation as of boardDate; resolve stable identities via existing adjudicated registration/current-season pathway.
